description: Source code for the HttpConnection class and its nested classes ReadIOBuffer and QueuedWriteIOBuffer, implementing buffer management and socket connection handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpConnection
classes.description: Represents an HTTP connection managing read/write buffers and WebSocket association.

classes.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer
classes.description: Manages read buffer with capacity adjustments and data consumption.

classes.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer
classes.description: Manages queued write buffer with multiple data chunks and capacity control.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns the current capacity of the read buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::SetCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of the read buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::IncreaseCapacity
methods.description: Attempts to increase the buffer capacity, respecting max size.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::StartOfBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the start of the buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::GetSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of data in the buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::DidRead
methods.description: Updates buffer state after reading bytes.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::RemainingCapacity
methods.description: Returns remaining capacity in the buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::DidConsume
methods.description: Handles data consumption, moving unconsumed data and adjusting capacity.

methods.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer::Append
methods.description: Appends data to the write queue if within size limits.

methods.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer::DidConsume
methods.description: Updates queue after data is sent/consumed.

methods.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer::GetSizeToWrite
methods.description: Returns size of data pending to write.

methods.name: HttpConnection::HttpConnection
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection with socket and buffers.

methods.name: HttpConnection::SetWebSocket
methods.description: Associates a WebSocket with the connection.
